purpose: a pharmacist explaining a prescription label to a customer across the counter, so the reader sees that advice comes with the medicine

style.look: warm documentary editorial, natural colour, matte skin
style.color_palette: sage green cabinetry, warm white walls, pale wood counter, one amber accent from the window
style.texture: fine 35 mm grain, matte surfaces, even diffuse highlights

location.place: the dispensing counter of a small neighbourhood pharmacy
locale_details: the shelf labels and the price tags carry Thai script
the pharmacist wears a short-sleeved white coat over a polo shirt, the common Thai pharmacy dress
a floor-standing fan sits at the end of the counter
the floor is large-format grey porcelain tile, the standard Thai shophouse floor

subjects.appearance: mid-thirties, medium build, black hair tied back, warm light-brown skin
subjects.wardrobe: short-sleeved white dispensing coat over a navy polo shirt, a plain unprinted lanyard
subjects.pose: standing behind the counter, weight on both feet, torso turned a quarter toward the customer, shoulders level
subjects.hands: her left hand holds the medicine box at its base; her right index finger points at the label on its front, the fingertip beside the printed panel so the panel stays visible
subjects.gaze: down at the box, toward where her finger points
subjects.expression: explaining, mouth slightly open mid-sentence, eyebrows relaxed
subjects.action: points at a line on the medicine label while explaining the dose
subjects.position: left of centre, behind the counter, facing across it

subjects.appearance: early sixties, slight build, short grey hair, glasses
subjects.wardrobe: pale blue short-sleeved shirt, dark trousers
subjects.pose: standing on the near side of the counter, leaning in slightly from the waist, both arms resting on the counter edge
subjects.hands: both hands rest flat on the counter, fingers relaxed and apart
subjects.gaze: down at the medicine box the pharmacist holds
subjects.action: leans in to read the label she is pointing at
subjects.position: right of centre, nearer the camera, back three-quarters to the lens

objects.name: pale wood dispensing counter
objects.material: oak-veneer laminate on a white base unit
objects.size: 0.9 m high, 2.4 m long, 0.6 m deep
objects.scale_anchor: its top meets the pharmacist just above the hip, a little below her waist
objects.position: runs across the lower third of the frame, separating the two people

objects.name: small white medicine carton with a blank label panel
objects.scale_anchor: it fits inside the pharmacist's hand with her fingers wrapping most of its width
objects.position: just above the counter near the centre of the frame, tilted slightly toward the customer

objects.name: wall of sage-green medicine shelving with boxed stock
objects.material: painted MDF shelves, cardboard stock boxes
objects.scale_anchor: its top shelf sits well above the pharmacist's head, about a third taller than she is
objects.position: fills the frame behind the pharmacist

spatial_layout.foreground: the customer's shoulder and forearms on the counter edge, slightly soft
spatial_layout.midground: the pharmacist, the counter top and the medicine box, all sharp
spatial_layout.background: the stocked sage-green shelving, soft but still readable as shelving

key.source: daylight through the shopfront window out of frame
key.quality: soft, because the window is large and close and the sky is overcast

fill: cool ceiling fluorescent tubes lifting the shadow side by about one stop
bounce off the white counter base under the chins

composition.subject_placement: the two faces sit on the left and right thirds, the medicine box on the centre line between them, the counter running as a horizontal through the lower third
composition.negative_space: the upper right quarter, where the shelving goes soft
composition.crop_safety: both faces and the medicine box stay inside a centre square, so the 1:1 and 4:5 crops lose only the shelving

physical_invariants: the counter separates the two people: each keeps their arms on their own side of it
the medicine box is small enough to sit in one hand and stays smaller than the pharmacist's forearm
the customer stands nearer the camera, so he reads noticeably larger in the frame than the pharmacist although he is only 6 cm taller
both people stand on the same floor, so their feet sit on one ground plane and their eye lines fall within a few centimetres of each other and of the horizon
the shelving behind is parallel to the counter, so both recede to the same vanishing point
must_not_show: readable brand names or drug names on any box
a doctor's long white coat or a stethoscope, which belong to a clinic rather than a pharmacy
retouched glossy skin or specular bloom
